deviations.constraint: RC2 may produce one final post-review repair candidate for the exact confirmed findings. No further hidden fix loop, provider expansion, push, tag, publish, install, or merge is authorized by this deviation.
deviations.remediation: Future release plans count full-profile executions rather than only published receipts and define explicitly whether test-only repairs consume the candidate budget.

deviations.constraint: The ordinary product candidate does not mutate the user-owned Swarm vault or claim that its plan index is product execution evidence.
deviations.remediation: After accepted product handoff, update terminal/deferred Swarm plan status through one validated vault-write transaction.
